semanticModel.businessPreferences: Keeping Score is one person's baseball attendance record: George "Wax" Weatherwax's 178 attended MLB games, 1984-2025. When the user says I, me, my, mine, or we, they mean the ENTIRE model. Never filter by attendee, attendee_key, Game_Attendee, or the current Salesforce user unless the question names a specific attendee by name. Game_Attendee lists companions who came to games with Wax. Governed measures: Games_Attended, Unique_Stadiums, Home_Runs_Witnessed, Runs_Witnessed, Hall_of_Famers_Seen, Attended_Win_Rate (grouped by Attended_Team_Games.team_id; NYA = New York Yankees). Game_Year is the calculated year dimension.
semanticModel.description: Governed semantic model over the two-cloud federated corpus: attended games, attendees, plays (BigQuery) + Lahman people/HOF (Databricks). Seven governed metrics; the four-way join as native relationships.
semanticModel.label: Keeping Score
